# WaitMouse <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
WaitMouse:Int32
```

**Returns:** The number of the button that was pressed.

## Description

Stops the program until a mouse button is pressed and returns its number. Presses made before the call count too, so call [FlushMouse](FlushMouse) first if only a new click should end the wait. In a game loop prefer [MouseHit](MouseHit) or [GetMouse](GetMouse), which let the screen keep updating.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
FlushMouse
Text 10, 10, "Click a mouse button"
Flip
Local b = WaitMouse()
Cls
Text 10, 10, "Button " + b + " was pressed"
Flip
Delay 1000
```
